messages:
Anya Patel: Heads-up — we need to lock the newsletter cadence and the launch email for the benchmark webinar next Wednesday. Can we decide cohort splits + send windows today?
Matt Chen: for cohorts I propose: 1) Product trial users, 2) Eng/ML subscribers, 3) Enterprise/account holders. Keep the creative similar but tweak CTAs.
Sophie Alvarez: subject line options: A) 'How top teams cut inference cost by 3x — webinar' B) 'Benchmark results: real latency & cost wins' C) shorter: 'Benchmark webinar: reduce LLM serving cost' — vote? :ballot_box_with_check: 
Eli Rosen: vote B (more concrete). Also recommend enterprise subject variant that drops 'webinar' and mentions SLA/scale.
Anya Patel: +1 B for broad list, separate enterprise variant. What about send windows? Global audience but primary NA/EMEA.
Matt Chen: staggered sends: NA Wed 10am PT, EMEA Wed 10am GMT, APAC Thur 10am SGT. Keeps timing aligned with local mornings.
Sophie Alvarez: Agree. For the newsletter drip: initial invite, reminder (48h), last-chance (3h). Also follow-up with recording + benchmark TL;DR + CTA to book demo.
Eli Rosen: inbound routing: make sure clicks from enterprise cohort hit HubSpot list 'Bench-Webinar-Enterprise' and trigger SDR sequence. Non-enterprise clicks -> nurture drip and product plays. Use firmographic rules: company_size > 250 OR tagged as "enterprise".
Marcom Bot: Created calendar event: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/bench-webinar-draft — added draft copy.
Anya Patel: Good. Sophie, can you draft the 1st email copy and include two CTAs: 'Register' (primary) and 'See benchmark snapshot' (secondary)? Keep hero stat up top.
Sophie Alvarez: Will do. Draft highlights: hero stat, 3 bullets (latency, cost, regression-free), speaker line, CTA. Keeping copy short.
Matt Chen: A/B test subject lines A vs B, and test CTA color (blue vs emerald) for Eng cohort. Keep sample size ~10k per variant if possible.
Eli Rosen: Tracking: add UTM template: `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_v1&utm_content={cohort}_{variant}`. Also set `utm_term` for subject variant if we want.
Sophie Alvarez: I'll include the UTM in every button and link. Also adding a hidden input so HubSpot captures cohort tag on click.
Anya Patel: Metrics to monitor first 48h: delivery rate, open rate, CTR, reg conversion rate, and demo bookings. Set dashboard so we can compare cohorts and variants side-by-side.
Matt Chen: I'll mock the dashboard tiles. Can we also surface cost per registration (paid ad equivalent) and CPL for sales? Helps justify SDR time.
Eli Rosen: For the SDR handoff, ensure lead scoring increments for webinar registrants + watched >50% recording. Follow-up cadence: 1) quick thank-you 24h, 2) tailored case study 3 days, 3) book-a-demo nudge 7 days.
Sophie Alvarez: Draft subject variants + first email by EOD. I'll push to the content doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/bench-webinar-copy (comment when ready).
Anya Patel: Nice. Final asks: 1) Sophie, deliver copy + alt subject lines, 2) Matt, set up A/B test config & dashboard, 3) Eli, confirm HubSpot routing + SDR flow. We’ll do a quick sync 4pm PT to sign off.
Matt Chen: on it.
Eli Rosen: Confirming SDR flow — I'll add the playbook to the doc and notify SDRs.
Sophie Alvarez: Draft up in 30m.
Marcom Bot: Reminder set for 4:00 PM PT sign-off meeting. :alarm_clock:
Anya Patel: Thanks team — if no blockers, we'll ship the invite tomorrow morning to the Eng cohort and the broader list after QA.
Matt Chen: minor note — can we localize subject line for EMEA (metric formatting & timezone)? I'll add localized variants in the test config.
Sophie Alvarez: good catch. Will adapt.
Eli Rosen: Also: add a short in-email GIF showing 2x latency improvement — high signal for non-technical execs. Keep file <500KB.
Anya Patel: Approved. Keep it tight.
Sophie Alvarez: uploading mock GIF and draft now.
Anya Patel: Perfect. See you at 4pm.
